articles.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Anthropic PBC has struck a $9.1 billion deal with Riot Platforms (RIOT), a Bitcoin mining company that recently began selling AI data center capacity. Riot disclosed it had secured a 20-year deal to supply 191 megawatts of capacity from its Rockdale, Texas, campus to a "leading frontier AI" company. - Rocket Lab (RKLB) shares drop as much as 5.7% after the company's Neutron timeline softened, with an analyst saying that while Neutron remains on track to reach launch pad in the fourth quarter, it could push an initial launch to 2027. - Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises (BW) rose in premarket after the company signed an agreement with Siemens Energy to produce steam turbine generator sets. - US-listed shares in On Holding (ONON) drop as much as 17% in premarket trading after the Swiss sneaker maker's second-quarter sales were lower than expected.
